analysis.title: Playful 3D Landscape SaaS Hero
analysis.notes: A saturated turquoise sky transitions into a deep green rolling landscape filled with whimsical molded 3D objects and soft directional shadows. The composition pairs oversized white headline typography with bright pill buttons and a large rounded social-proof panel below.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a wide website hero illustration in a whimsical tactile 3D style: a turquoise painted sky above rolling deep-green hills, with floating and grounded abstract objects including a colorful funnel, curled blue tube, magnifying glass, small windmill, mailbox, stacked orange blocks, and simple cone-shaped trees. Use soft clay-like materials, rounded edges, subtle grain, gentle ambient shadows, and vivid cyan, teal, lime, orange, cream, and blue accents. Leave open darker green space in the lower center-left for white headline text. No logos, branding, readable text, or interface elements.
